newsitem.title: USA: ACM Managed Dollar to begin tender offer.
newsitem.headline: ACM Managed Dollar to begin tender offer.

text.p: ACM Managed Dollar Income Fund said on Wednesday that it will begin a tender offer on May 8 for 7,081,253 shares of its common stock.
The offer, representing about 25 percent of the fund's outstanding shares, is for cash, and will expire on June 5 at 12:00 midnight local time in New York, the company said.

Assuming the expiration date is not extended, the offer will be for a price equal to the net asset value per share determined at the close of the regular trading session of the NYSE the following day, June 6.
ACM is a a non-diversified management investment company with current net assets of about $396 million, the company said.
